Container.Name: Covalent
Container.Overview: Private distributed backup with explicit replicas and signed, authorized-root restore preview. Read-only source and optional boot mappings prevent container writes to backup inputs.
Container.Requires: Map each selected share separately as read-only. Optional /boot backup must also be read-only. Add a distinct writable restore target only when restoring. Set the exact HTTPS hostname and enroll the durable local CA before entering the API token.

Config.Name: HTTPS console
Config.Description: TLS-only console and API port. Cleartext management is loopback-only inside the container.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Durable operator-managed safe settings and deployment files. Keep separate from selected shares.

Config.Name: Encrypted storage
Config.Description: Durable encrypted chunk, manifest, identity, and key state. Back up this appdata path separately.

Config.Name: Selected backup source
Config.Description: One explicitly selected /mnt/user share. Add more read-only paths as needed.

Config.Name: Optional boot backup
Config.Description: Optional read-only /boot mapping for boot-drive backup.

Config.Name: Restore target
Config.Description: Explicit writable target used only after restore preview and confirmation.

Config.Name: HTTPS hostname
Config.Description: Exact DNS name clients use for HTTPS certificate validation. Enroll the CA from /config/caddy/data/caddy/pki/authorities/local/root.crt.

Config.Name: Peer listen address
Config.Description: Authenticated QUIC bind address and port.

Config.Name: LAN discovery
Config.Description: Enable mDNS advertisements. Pairing remains required.

Config.Name: File creation umask
Config.Description: Three-digit octal umask for runtime-created files.
